title: Proper direct image, base change and projection formula for $\mathcal O_E$
statement:
Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite and $p\colon X\to Y$ proper between standing schemes.

1. For $K\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$, $Rp_*K$ is derived $\pi_E$-complete, and
   $(Rp_*K)\otimes^{\mathbf L}\cO_{E,Y}/\pi_E\simeq Rp_*(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}\cO_{E,X}/\pi_E)$;
   hence $Rp_*K\in\Dbc(Y,\cO_E)$.
2. (Derived Nakayama.) A derived $\pi_E$-complete $C$ with $C\otimes^{\mathbf L}\cO_E/\pi_E=0$ is
   zero.
3. The proper base change map and the projection formula map are isomorphisms for
   $K\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)$, $M\in\Dbc(Y,\cO_E)$.

proof.text: Derive the noetherian and qcqs instances for the standing schemes. The internal residue criterion makes K complete and its first reduction bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude. Internal direct-image limits gives completeness and the actual first-reduction direct-image comparison. The existing proper_integralModel_bounded argument gives constructibility of the proper direct image.
Apply the vanishing clause of the existing first-reduction derived Nakayama theorem to obtain assertion (2).

Prove completeness of an arbitrary pullback of a bounded constructible object from a qcqs scheme: restrict to the affine cover of the target. Bounded constructible pullback on qcqs schemes, proved in the localizing-pullback dependency, gives bounded constructibility on each affine chart. The complete_sheaf and complete_triangulated arguments of qcqs-integral-finite-model-completeness and bounded Postnikov induction give completeness there. The strict completion presentation commutes with the covering open immersions, including its unit. Covering restrictions jointly detect invertibility of that unit, hence give global completeness. Derived pullback agrees with the exact termwise functor and its composition comparison. Apply this to g and g-prime. Internal direct-image limits preserves completeness along arbitrary p-prime, without a finite-type assumption on X-prime or Y-prime.

For the projection map use bounded constructible pullback on the standing schemes, the integral tensor-closure theorem, proper integral constructibility, and completeness of bounded constructible objects to make both endpoints complete. All tensors remain the ambient uncompleted tensors.

The residue criterion puts the input first reductions in Dctf. Apply integralResidueProperFormulas, the separate finite-coefficient step of source paragraph (3), to show that derivedReduction maps each actual canonical arrow to an isomorphism. Apply the first-reduction isomorphism criterion to the complete endpoints established above. This gives the actual ambient exchange and projection map, not chosen isomorphisms between the endpoints.

Statement, stmt_deps and lean match live exactly. No SGA, and the item is not dropped. Old steps 3, 7 and 8 became lem-sfb-integral-quotient-direct-image-comparison, -exchange-comparison and -projection-comparison. Old steps 5 and 10 are det-pe-derived-nakayama-first-reduction, whose statement contains them. Old steps 1, 2, 4, 6 and 9 are citation assembly of existing nodes. Direct-image node: true for every f and unbounded K, since pi^n is regular on R_T, D_n is the cone of pi^n, V is conservative and V rho composed with d_f is the perfect-projection map. It is not a duplicate: the existing node is in D(R_Y), restriction is not fully faithful, and lem-fix-operation-reduction is bounded. Exchange and projection nodes: types and lambda/lambda^-1 orientation checked; both are true by mate calculus. The exchange node is the sfb framework's version of the def-weil-pbc rectangle plus a bridge clause, not a duplicate. Parent steps 3-7 were checked against the finite theorem (1)-(3), integral-models (2),(3), direct-image-limits, permanence (b),(e) and the Nakayama iso criterion, which needs no bound. Edge cases checked: n=1 and n>1, E=Q_l and ramified E, f=id, zero inputs. Batch-5 flag: lem-trf-derived-pullback-coherence is generic derived-pullback associativity, not trace-formula or Poincare-duality content. It was already in the closure of the parent's non-new deps, and the new nodes add no trf or pd node, so accepted. All 11 tool_uses accepted. FIX (item only): step 1 restores R_T = lim(P_n)_T rather than constant A, the cartesian-coefficient exact pullback and the identification of the sfb operations with the ringed-topos ones used by direct-image-limits and the finite theorem. Step 5 restores why X' is standing: (b) proper, (e) separated and finite type, quasi-compact composite.
